scenario: Third edge added would close a cycle: s1 -> s2 -> s3 -> s1
expected: Reject — plan and draft both describe Mission Plan sub-goals as "DAG-structured" (acyclic by definition)

actual.errorMessage: MissionPlanSO edge rejected: would create a cycle (s3 -> s1) — Mission Plan sub-goals must form a DAG

classification: Fixed — was a real gap (Type I, our own code)
note: Prior to this fix, addEdge() only validated that from_step_id/to_step_id referenced existing steps, with no cycle check at all — a cyclic edge set was accepted silently, directly contradicting the "DAG-structured" claim made about this component in both the plan and the draft. Fixed by adding a DFS-based cycle check over the proposed edge set before committing any new edge. Classified as our own implementation bug (Type I), not a draft ambiguity, since "DAG" is an unambiguous mathematical term we chose to use.
